interpretation_policy: A source URL, index entry, consolidated text or amendment candidate does not by itself prove a rule's legal effect. Instrument commencement and rule-specific operative effect are separate determinations.

primary_source_precedence: Original Bangladesh Gazette (Extraordinary/Weekly as applicable) published by Department of Printing and Publications / Bangladesh Government Press
Authenticated Act/Ordinance/SRO/Rules/notification signed or promulgated by the constitutionally/statutorily competent authority and matched to its Gazette publication
Official issuing-authority record (BSEC, Bangladesh Bank, NBR, RJSC, ministry) where the instrument is validly issued under enabling law; Gazette publication checked where required
Official consolidated BDLaws text as a cross-check and research index, not a replacement for original Gazette wording
Secondary commentary, websites, commercial databases and OCR only as discovery aids; never sole legal authority
minimum_authentication_fields: issuer identity and legal competence / enabling provision
instrument title, type, number and year
signature, authentication, seal or promulgation marker where applicable
Gazette series, issue/date, supplement status, page range and publication date
DPP index record matching the PDF title, date, issuing body and page range
original artifact URL and SHA-256 captured from downloaded bytes
Bangla source text manually checked against page image; OCR compared but not treated as authoritative
correction/corrigendum/reprint status and any later withdrawal or supersession
commencement clause, retrospective effect, savings, transition and repeal clauses
retrieval timestamp, reviewer, review method and evidence custody

issuer_specific_checks.ACT: Jatiya Sangsad enactment; verify Act number/year, presidential assent/promulgation text, Gazette publication date and commencement clause.
issuer_specific_checks.ORDINANCE: Verify constitutional authority, promulgation/publication, commencement, laying/approval/continuance where relevant, repeal/re-enactment and savings.
issuer_specific_checks.SRO_OR_RULE: Verify delegated rulemaker and enabling section, SRO/rule number, signatory/authority, Gazette issue and date, territorial/personal scope, commencement and amendments.
issuer_specific_checks.REGULATOR_CODE_OR_NOTIFICATION: Verify statutory regulator, enabling provision, Board/Commission resolution, notification number/date, official issuer-hosted signed copy, Gazette record where applicable, addressees, applicability and supersession.
issuer_specific_checks.CENTRAL_BANK_CIRCULAR: Verify Bangladesh Bank department, circular reference/date, signed official PDF, legal basis, addressees, effective date, scope, replacement/cancellation and official archive.
issuer_specific_checks.TAX_NBR_SRO: Verify NBR/Ministry of Finance competence, enabling tax provision, SRO number, Gazette publication, tax period, retrospective/transition and taxpayer category.
issuer_specific_checks.ADMINISTRATIVE_GUIDELINE: Treat as guidance unless a statutory or delegated instrument makes it binding; identify exact enabling provision and legal effect before using as a compliance rule.
issuer_specific_checks.PRIVATE_COMPANY_RECORD: Authenticate from the statutory custodian/issuer (company, auditor, RJSC, bank, court) separately from legislation; verify entity, authorisation, signature, date, contemporaneous register and chain of custody.

issuer_document_authentication_standard.evidence_integrity: Preserve original bytes, compute SHA-256 locally, record retrieval time and custodian, retain page-level references, and record discrepancies. Never populate artifact_sha256 from a URL or guessed value.

interval_method.date_convention: from inclusive; to_exclusive exclusive; null end means not yet established as ended, not proof of continuing force.
steps: Identify exact proposition and exact provision/subsection/paragraph/schedule for the rule.
Establish parent instrument commencement from its own commencement clause and Gazette.
Enumerate every amendment, substitution, repeal, delegated rule, SRO, regulator instrument, corrigendum and binding judicial order affecting that exact provision or proposition.
For each instrument, separately record assent/publication date and legal effective date; do not equate them unless the commencement clause says so.
Apply retrospective clauses only to their stated scope and subject to constitutional/statutory validity and savings/transitional clauses.
Split intervals at each legally operative change; preserve old/new wording and affected event-date logic.
Have independent Bangladesh counsel approve the provision mapping, source chain, scope and interval; hash the reviewed payload.
prohibited_inferences: current consolidated text proves historical wording on a past date
a section number alone proves the candidate rule is within that section
a regulator guideline is binding legislation without an enabling/legal-effect analysis
a current amendment changes every rule that cites the parent Act
